david-blaining-manager.concept: A male canonical Manager Homie in an all-black street-magician outfit makes a visible arc of playing cards fly between his deck and open hand.
david-blaining-manager.action_expectation: The same complete Manager body, deck, hands and five inner cards stay locked while the detached outer card travels outward and upward through a controlled arc.

cranking-that-marketing.concept: The male canonical Marketing Homie wears the supplied white graffiti jacket and black/yellow Crank That wardrobe while holding the recognizable Superman balance pose.
cranking-that-marketing.action_expectation: Both complete sleeve-arm-hand units sweep in opposite directions around fixed shoulders while the face, cap, wraparound shades, jacket core, red shirt, planted leg and raised rear leg remain locked.

cranking-the-step-marketing.concept: The male canonical Marketing Homie wears the supplied Crank That wardrobe in the crossed-foot small-hop step.
cranking-the-step-marketing.action_expectation: Two complete bent sleeve-arm-fist units pump around fixed shoulder joins while the cap, wraparound shades, face, jacket core, crossed legs and both shoes remain locked.

cranking-the-motorbike-marketing.concept: The male canonical Marketing Homie wears the supplied Crank That wardrobe in the low motorcycle-rev dance step.
cranking-the-motorbike-marketing.action_expectation: Both complete forearm-fist units counter-rotate around fixed elbows like revving handlebars while the head, jacket core, upper sleeves, bent knees, baggy pants and shoes remain locked.
